subject.title: [Feature]: Diffs viewer: per-file +/- stats and multi-file summary navigation

question: Should the Diffs plugin ship the linked SSR changed-files summary/navigation and static-export toolbar suppression as the intended viewer/export UX?
rationale: The source gap is real and the linked PR is bounded, but the issue is protected for maintainer review and changes user-visible Diffs viewer and export output.

options.title: Review And Land Linked PR
options.body: Approve the plugin-local summary/nav and image-mode toolbar behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100753 after normal maintainer review.

options.title: Narrow The UX
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask the linked PR to split summary/navigation from toolbar suppression if maintainers want separate design review.

options.title: Backlog The Feature
options.body: Leave this as a low-priority Diffs viewer ergonomics request if the export/viewer change is not wanted now.

recommendation.title: Review And Land Linked PR
recommendation.body: Approve the plugin-local summary/nav and image-mode toolbar behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100753 after normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the request and has the strongest current evidence trail on the Diffs viewer/export direction.
